pages.text: The $(l)High Princess$() is a powerful commander on the battlefield. She directs combat by summoning varied minions while maintaining strong defenses.

pages.title: Unit Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 60$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 20$(br2)Capable of commanding both melee and ranged allies to overload enemy formations.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(li)$(4)Summoning:$() Calls Goblins, Recruits, Ogres, Guards, Shooters, Ents, and Trolls to her side.$(li)$(6)Stat Boost:$() Minions inherit and gain bonuses from the same boosters active on her.
Crafted with royal authority and summoning essences.
And the most important thing is her crown.
